title: SpendShield on Aevum testnet
tagline: Every event the SpendShield contract has emitted on Aevum testnet since it was deployed at block 3581556: payments agents made, the limits and merchants owners set, deposits, withdrawals and approval requests. Amounts are tUSD8 with 6 decimals.

queries.title: Latest agent payments
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, owner, agent, merchant, CAST(amount_dec AS DOUBLE) / 1e6 AS amount_usd FROM spend_shield__agent_paid ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Payments per day
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM payments_by_day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 14

queries.title: Recent policy changes
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, owner, agent, kind, detail FROM policy_changes ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Approval requests and their outcome
queries.sql: SELECT id, owner, agent, merchant, amount_usd, outcome FROM approval_requests ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Spend per owner and merchant
queries.sql: SELECT owner, merchant, count(*) AS payments, sum(CAST(amount_dec AS DOUBLE)) / 1e6 AS amount_usd FROM spend_shield__agent_paid WHERE NOT amount_overflow GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY amount_usd DESC LIMIT 20

prompts: What changes have owners made to their agents' permissions recently? Use the policy_changes view, newest first, and summarise how many of each kind there are.
For each owner wallet, how many approval requests did their agents raise, and how many were approved, rejected or still pending? Use the approval_requests view.
How much did agents pay per day, in tUSD8 (6 decimals)? Use the payments_by_day view for the last 14 days and name the busiest day.
Which merchants received the most from agents, and from which owners? Use table spend_shield__agent_paid, amount_dec divided by 1e6.
List every table and view in this nest with its row count, then say in two sentences what the data is good for.
